prompts.title: Beauty-
prompts.text: Ultra-realistic DSLR close-up portrait of a beautiful young South Asian woman sitting gracefully outdoors in a lush green garden. She has long dark hair styled half-up with small white floral hair accessories, wearing a sheer white traditional outfit with delicate pink and green floral embroidery, silver jhumka earrings, a small bindi, red lipstick, and a rose-gold wristwatch. She gently rests her chin on her hand while holding a bouquet of vibrant red roses. Looking directly at the camera with a soft natural smile. Warm morning sunlight, creamy green bokeh background, cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, luxury editorial fashion photography, HDR, ultra-detailed, photorealistic. frame size 4:5

prompts.title: Style
prompts.text: Ultra-realistic cinematic portrait of a stylish South Asian man sitting confidently in the driver's seat of a red Lamborghini convertible with the driver's door open, wearing a tailored navy blue suit over a white crew-neck T-shirt, white luxury sneakers, black aviator sunglasses, and a premium wristwatch. He has neatly styled short black hair, a well-groomed beard and mustache, and a confident expression. The background features a modern futuristic city skyline with iconic glass skyscrapers, luxury business district architecture, and a dramatic cloudy sunset sky with soft golden-hour light. Shot from a low-angle perspective using a Sony A7R V, 35mm lens, f/1.8, HDR, shallow depth of field, natural skin tones, ultra-sharp focus, realistic reflections on the car, cinematic color grading, photorealistic, luxury lifestyle, editorial fashion photography, 8K Ultra HD, highly detailed, masterpiece quality.
